decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge we credit up to $100 right away. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 4 weeks. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 2%, up to $10 cash back.
